svg.data-weight-note: 10.005 kg (20.05 lb) per the datasheet. The quick start's own table says 13.48 kg with two PSUs and six fans installed; see the-two-documents-disagree-about-the-chassis.
svg.data-optics-osfp: datasheet: each OSFP800 port takes 1 x 800G or breaks out to 2 x 400 GbE, 4 x 200 GbE or 8 x 100 GbE. Named cables and modules: "800G OSFP SR8 100 m, 800G OSFP 2 x SR4 100 m, 800G OSFP DR8 500 m, 800G OSFP 2 x DR4 500 m", plus DAC/AOC/AEC direct to the cage.

g.data-description: the 1PPS timing input - a single coaxial jack beside the system lamps, labelled 1PPS on the metal. THE DATASHEET CALLS IT AN SMA; the elevation draws it at 5 mm, which is SMB scale, and common/smb-jack@1 is seated on that basis. It states no group media because coax is not a pluggable cage and L40's optics question does not apply to it.
g.title: pps-in

g.data-description: the captive pull-out information tab at the foot of the panel - a thing you neither connect to nor read off the face.
g.title: info-tab

g.data-description: the sixteen OSFP800 ports, NUMBERED FROM ZERO. The panel prints 0 and 1 under the first column and 14 and 15 under the last, numbering down each column.
